name: Server Meshing
description:
Splits a map across several map-server processes ("cells") with seamless handoff, ghosting across cell edges, seams between maps, cells of any size and on-demand ("sleeping") cells.
Players cross a cell edge without a loading screen; neighbouring cells exchange ghosts of everything near their shared edge, so combat, loot, quests and building resolve across it. Empty land costs nothing: a cell with nobody near it does not run.
Subclasses on the kit's managers and entity prefabs plus one world-registry asset — the kit's core is not modified. Includes a Setup window that validates a project and fixes what it can.
